relationship_to_translation: Scholarly dictionary and methodological companion; not a replacement for the mathematical reader.

entry_identifiers.TERM: Distinct historical source–target pair; not automatically a current recommendation.
entry_identifiers.DEC: Documented linguistic or editorial choice. Editorial reasoning can be retrospective; see entry.

evidence_policy.source_mathematics: The exact source work controls the mathematical claim; diplomatic readings and proposed emendations remain distinct.
evidence_policy.official_language: Exact Interslavic dictionary/grammar evidence supports only the senses and forms it actually attests.
evidence_policy.comparative_languages: Russian and Ukrainian comparison translations are AI-produced and are not independent human linguistic authorities. Consult source-linked scholarship where supplied.
evidence_policy.weights: Preserve real recorded numerical weights. Confidence estimates are uncalibrated editorial judgments, not probabilities.
evidence_policy.reuse: Preserve source identity, cited passages, rejected alternatives, uncertainty, contextual applicability, and human authorship. Do not fabricate earlier consultation.
